## Description

Uses causal discovery algorithms (e.g. PC algorithm, NOTEARS) to infer directed causal graphs between stock prices, selecting lead-lag pairs based on direct causal links rather than spurious linear correlation.

## Where it may fit

Statistical arbitrage pair selection, avoiding breakdown in spurious correlations during market shocks.

## Vehicles

Quantitative market-neutral equity hedge funds, statistical arbitrage desks.

## Required data

High-frequency or daily asset return time series, macroeconomic control variables.

## Caveats

Causal DAG estimation is sensitive to unobserved confounding variables and temporal resolution.
